traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and listed requirements in docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md are implemented and verified. The valid-annotation-format ESLint rule provides core format and syntax validation for @story and @req (plus @supports) via src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts, including multi-line handling and flexible whitespace. Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts comprehensively cover valid and invalid patterns, multi-line scenarios, path traversal, missing values, and detailed error message contents that reference expected examples, thereby satisfying REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION, REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION, REQ-PATH-FORMAT, REQ-REQ-FORMAT, REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT, REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING, and REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY. Documentation in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md describes the format specification with concrete examples of correct and incorrect annotations. Integration with other annotation rules is ensured by inclusion of valid-annotation-format in the plugin’s rule registry and recommended/strict configs, verified by plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts. All tests, including the suite explicitly tied to this story, pass in the Jest test run. Therefore this story is fully implemented and passes.
